# RegisterMySite

> RegisterMySite is a web development agency that builds multi-platform online presence for businesses.

RegisterMySite helps local and service-based businesses move from scattered listings to a professional, unified online presence.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://registermysite.com/): Overview of services, how it works, and value proposition
- [About](https://registermysite.com/about): Company background and service summary
- [Templates & Tools](https://registermysite.com/templates): Industry-ready website templates
- [Documentation](https://registermysite.com/docs): Step-by-step guide to domain search, registration, and setup
- [API Reference](https://registermysite.com/api): Endpoints for authentication (Google/GitHub) and more

## Services

- [Domain & DNS Setup](https://registermysite.com/): Register or connect domains, configure DNS
- [SEO Optimization](https://registermysite.com/): Technical SEO, schema markup, local SEO, and more
- [Web Design & Templates](https://registermysite.com/templates): Responsive, mobile-first, conversion-focused designs
- [Custom Business Email](https://registermysite.com/): Professional @yourbusiness.com addresses

## Optional

- [Domain Search Tool](https://registermysite.com/tools/Domain_Search): Check domain availability
- [Contact / Start Project](https://registermysite.com/): Reach the team to begin a project
